provenance: Independent Wikidata P345 confirms title identity claims only. Source tests supply intended release identity and episode/range expectations; no deployed MatchLab answer was used as its own oracle.
limitations: 300 generated variants cover only 30 works and are correlated.
Source fixture metadata can differ from production; synthetic IDs were excluded.
Source cases include legacy non-strict expectations; mode is preserved.
Absent expected ASID keys mean unasserted, not null.
Unqualified ambiguous titles do not establish intent. Case classifications intentionally avoid universal identifier-precision claims.
